title: Order the steps of checking an AI claim
displayTitle: Order the steps of checking an AI claim
body: When an AI states something as fact, you check it. Put the steps in order.
instruction: Drag the steps into the right order, then select Submit.

_items.text: Identify the exact claim the AI has made.
Check whether it gives a source you can follow.
Find an independent, trusted source on the same point.
Compare the two and note where they differ.
Decide whether to use, verify further, or reject the claim.

_feedback.title: Checking a claim
_feedback.correct: That is the order. Name the claim, look for its source, find an independent one, compare, then decide.

_incorrect.final: Not quite. Start by naming the claim, then look for sources before you compare and decide.
_incorrect.notFinal: Not quite. Think about what you need before you can compare anything, and try again.
